title: appendix-ccp12-hopping.md:172: No guard against SuperframeDuration_us = 0
description: SfnFromUnixTime divides by SuperframeDuration_us without validating it is non-zero. While the default constant is 2000000, the function signature accepts it as a parameter, and a configuration error could cause division by zero. Fix: Add guard IF SuperframeDuration_us = 0 THEN RETURN 0 or document that SuperframeDuration_us must be > 0.
